title: Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team receives first Neil Armstrong Space Prize for reusable rocket research
summary_en: Purdue University’s Neil Armstrong Space Prize was awarded to the SpaceX Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team, recognizing their globally impactful work on the Falcon 9 reusable two-stage rocket system.
title_cn: Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team receives first Neil Armstrong Space Prize for reusable rocket research

title: How SpaceX's Falcon 9 cracked rocket reusability: Purdue's 2026 Neil Armstrong Space Prize
summary_en: The Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team at SpaceX has been awarded the 2026 Neil Armstrong Space Prize in the Innovation category for proving that rockets could be recovered, refurbished and reused — a feat much of the industry once considered impossible.
title_cn: How SpaceX's Falcon 9 cracked rocket reusability: Purdue's 2026 Neil Armstrong Space Prize
